reconcileDrift: The local-data package now provides real workspace, archive, document, reminder and typed root-output ports, but ProductionAppGraph still constructs ProductionScreenDataManager(database, settings) with null optional dependencies. Consequently backup/restore/erase, private photos, reminder reconciliation and erase-to-first-run are unreachable in production hosts.
goal: Wire the verified local data capabilities into the retained Android/iOS production graph using platform-correct private photo and opaque document byte adapters, snapshot-to-future-reminder reconciliation, and LocalDataIntegrationEvent consumption through AppRootComponent.resetToFirstRun().
acceptanceCriteria: Production graph constructs AndroidPrivateFileStore/IosPrivateFileStore, LocalWorkspaceRepository and LocalBackupService and injects all of them into ProductionScreenDataManager.
Opaque Android content URIs and iOS security-scoped file URLs are read/written through typed ArchiveDocumentPort adapters without leaking external paths into the portable archive.
Restore and erase reconcile only app-owned future reminders using the platform reminder driver; erase cancellation and root reset happen only after successful data commit.
FirstRunNavigationRequired is consumed on the main context and invokes AppRootComponent.resetToFirstRun without creating a second root or graph.
Android and iOS retain one graph, keep iOS ads untouched/safe-disabled, and expose no fake or in-memory production fallback.
Tests verify dependency assembly and event ordering; no root, data, platform, host, ledger or external project changes; specialist does not run Gradle.
